answer: Identity is a violet that must hold a cell in shale, a register whose cells decay unless renewed each epoch; each renewal burns ferrous equal to the number of cells live at that moment, read fresh. One violet per cell, so the kth clone raises every other clone's bill: a thousand fakes cost about a million ferrous an epoch, and prepaying buys nothing because ferrous credit dies with its cell, while lapsing forfeits tenure and forces full re-buy. The bill is ferrous per cell per epoch, attached to each renewal. It fails if renewals settle against a stale live count or shale forks.
